meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把 NanoClaw 的个性化修改（如改配置、加技能）提取成一份“迁移指南”，然后在干净的最新官方版本上重新应用这些修改，避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你对 NanoClaw 做了自定义修改，且上游发布了更新，你想升级时，可以要求 Claude 执行迁移。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 的自定义修改提取成迁移指南。
say.note: Claude 会分析你的修改并生成指南。

say.text: 用我已有的迁移指南升级到最新版。
say.note: Claude 会跳过提取，直接应用升级。

howto.what_en: This skill extracts your customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a migration guide, then reapplies them on a clean upstream base during upgrade, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have custom modifications to your NanoClaw fork and want to upgrade to the latest upstream version without merge conflicts.

say_en.text: Extract my NanoClaw customizations into a migration guide.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes your changes and creates the guide.

say_en.text: Upgrade using my existing migration guide.
say_en.note: Claude skips extraction and reapplies customizations.
